subject: error message producing ROC curve for rpart model

messages.author: ad4948885468e71d
messages.subject: error message producing ROC curve for rpart model
parts:
Please find below a minimal example reproducing
an error message when producing an ROC curve
for an rpart model:

library(rattle)
library(rpart)
data(kyphosis)
rattle()

Data tab
- choose Data Name kyphosis as R Dataset
- Execute
Variables tab
- Execute
Transform tab
- uncheck Sample
- Execute
Explore tab
- Execute
Model tab
- tree (keep default settings)
- Execute
Evaluate tab
- check ROC
- Execute

The ROC curve is produced, but the following error message is
displayed in the R console:

Error in if (nummodels == 1 && grep("\\[test\\]", testname)) { :
missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

The error does not occur when I do not uncheck Sample in the Transform tab
(keeping all default settings).

Kind regards,
Tobias
